text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ――... Aah, dammit...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—Even after doing all this... it's "still" 
not enough...?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: "...Haha. What a crazy race that was."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Nah, you don't need to thank me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I decline the position of Japan's 
representative.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...I told you, didn't I? I want to make 
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe a scenery of 
my dreams.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So today, I was planning on wiping the 
floor with everyone here without breaking 
a sweat.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...And yet, it was far from an easy win. 
Even after I went through the trouble of 
timing my peak for it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —There is someone precious to me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I heard that the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe 
had been a lifelong dream of theirs.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I wanted them to be happy.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to give them a soul-stirring 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...However, competition is a world 
divided strictly into winners and losers."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
No matter how hard you fought, once you're 
the loser, it all just ends with 'too bad 
for you.'

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...I don't need a single shred of that 
kind of encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
What I want to make her feel isn't 
sympathy. Nor is it regret.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"I want to drown them only in thrilling 
victories— the kind that make you yearn 
for what comes next."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...I just want people to look forward to 
the future.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Then next time, I'll just bet everything 
on someone who can."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
As Umamusume, we understand each other 
just by running. Your growth has limitless 
potential.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hey, let me place a bet.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'll give everything to support you all. 
Feel free to take up all of my time while 
we're on this overseas tour.
choice_data_list:
Could that be why you stepped down as the 
representative...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Deliver results that shake people to their 
core.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
A race that captivates everyone in Japan. 
On that world stage everyone almost wrote 
off as "impossible"—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—Show me hope. Accomplish the things that 
I could never do.

...Everyone's 'Representative Exchange 
Race' had concluded. At Mei Satake's call, 
the project participants lined up in 
formation.

The Japanese representative team is about 
to be announced. If my name isn't called 
here—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Now, I will read out the names of the 
Umamusume chosen to represent us. The 
first is...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: <chrname>！

I exchange looks with <chrname>. This year, I can 
challenge the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe 
with her once again—!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: "...Haha. So you were chosen after all."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Teach.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Making a choice like this is fine once in 
a while, right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
And after your heart gets set ablaze by 
them... ————You'd better look forward to 
my day, too.
